pages.text: A long empty space remained on the classroom wall. Today's paintings would hang there.
Duri chose the biggest sheet of paper. The middle of the wall was Duri's place.
Halfway through painting blue, Duri jumped up. "I will finish later." The brush stayed on the paper.
Duri left two blocks half-stacked and put a hand in the sandbox. The two blocks stood all alone.
Duri grabbed and released a handful of sand. The painting still lay with its brush on top.
The children hung their paintings one by one. The wall became colorful.
Half of Duri's painting was white. Duri stood holding it in both hands.
Teacher Bau placed a chair beside Duri. "The paint will be dry if you come back later."
The next day, Duri sat on the chair and painted blue all the way to the end.
Duri's painting hung in the middle of the wall. A river stretched across it.
